name: Mekakure-chan Ijiraretai! ~Zettai ni Makeru to Wakatteru no ni Bakunyuu Yurashite Aori Chirasu Ore no Kouhai~
original_name: メカクレちゃんはイジられたいっ！ ～絶対に負けるとわかってるのに爆乳揺らして煽り散らす俺の後輩～
source:
Even when our eyes meet, she quickly looks away. She struggles to communicate well and is shy. Back then, she had this endearingly earnest charm...

“Senpai~ yoo-hoo~♪ Finally woke up, huh?♪”

“...Wait, hold up. What the hell are you doing?”

“Ah☆ It's a wake-up call with a titjob and blowjob!”

Now she half-teasingly challenges me to sexual contests. That smirk on her lips... I try to read her true intentions, but her hair falling over her eyes hides her expression. Yet the result is always the same.

“Senpai...! Too... too strong...! Too powerful...!”

I end up defeating her. Yet she keeps challenging me to rematches over and over.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt288/apt288.html#link_story]official site[/url]]
translation:
即使我们目光相遇，她也会很快移开视线。她很难很好地沟通并且很害羞。那时的她，有着一种让人怜爱的认真魅力……

“学长～呜呼～♪终于醒了啊？♪”

“……等等，等等。你到底在做什么？”

“啊☆乳头口交敲响了警钟！”

现在她半开玩笑地挑战我进行性竞赛。她嘴唇上的傻笑……我试图解读她的真实意图，但她的头发垂落在眼睛上，掩盖了她的表情。但结果总是一样的。

“学长……！太……太强了……！太强了……！”

我最终还是打败了她。然而她却不断地挑战我重赛。
